<div>
  <div class="match-record phone-layout centre-dialogs">
    <div class="ov-kit phone-scoreboard" data-testid="phone-scoreboard">
      <header>
        <span data-phone-pair-dock="" data-variant="phone">
        <div>
          <span data-testid="phone-header-sets">
            "Set 2 · sets 1 : 0"
          <div class="" data-testid="phone-header-teams">
            "VBC Musterau"
            "–"
            "VC Beispielstadt"
        <button aria-label="Undo" disabled="" title="Undo" type="button">
          <svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-undo-2" fill="none" height="20" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <path d="M9 14 4 9l5-5">
            <path d="M4 9h10.5a5.5 5.5 0 0 1 5.5 5.5a5.5 5.5 0 0 1-5.5 5.5H11">
        <button aria-label="Menu" title="Menu" type="button">
          <svg aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-menu" fill="none" height="20" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <path d="M4 5h16">
            <path d="M4 12h16">
            <path d="M4 19h16">
      <section aria-label="Score">
        <div>
          <div>
            <div class="" title="VC Beispielstadt">
              "B · VC Beispielstadt"
            <span aria-hidden="false" data-testid="phone-serve-pill">
              <span>
                "SERVE"
            <span>
              "Sets won: 0"
          <span data-testid="phone-score-left">
            "0"
        <div>
          <span data-testid="phone-score-right">
            "0"
          <div>
            <div class="" title="VBC Musterau">
              "A · VBC Musterau"
            <span aria-hidden="true">
              <span>
                "SERVE"
            <span>
              "Sets won: 1"
      <section aria-label="Court">
        <div class="phone-court">
          <div data-testid="phone-court-left">
            <button data-court-cell="V" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button data-court-cell="IV" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button data-court-cell="VI" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button data-court-cell="III" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button data-court-cell="I" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
                <span aria-label="SERVE" data-testid="phone-serve-ball">
            <button data-court-cell="II" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button type="button">
              <span>
                "Line-up"
              <span>
                "B · VC Beispielstadt"
          <div data-testid="phone-court-right">
            <button data-court-cell="II" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button data-court-cell="I" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button data-court-cell="III" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button data-court-cell="VI" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button data-court-cell="IV" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button data-court-cell="V" disabled="" type="button">
              <span>
                "–"
            <button type="button">
              <span>
                "Line-up"
              <span>
                "A · VBC Musterau"
      <section aria-label="Last actions" data-testid="phone-recent">
        <span>
          "No action in this set yet"
      <section aria-label="Team actions">
        <div>
          <button data-testid="phone-timeout-left" disabled="" type="button">
            <span>
              "Time-out"
            <span>
              "0"
          <button data-testid="phone-sub-left" disabled="" type="button">
            <span>
              "SUB"
            <span>
              "0"
        <div>
          <button data-testid="phone-timeout-right" disabled="" type="button">
            <span>
              "Time-out"
            <span>
              "0"
          <button data-testid="phone-sub-right" disabled="" type="button">
            <span>
              "SUB"
            <span>
              "0"
        <p data-testid="phone-request-block">
          "Set interval: no time-out (it would count in the next set)."
      <section aria-label="Point buttons">
        <div aria-hidden="true" class="phone-square">
        <div aria-hidden="true" class="phone-square">
        <div data-testid="phone-centre">
          <div>
            <div>
              "Interval between sets"
            <div data-testid="phone-countdown">
              "2:30"
            <div>
              <div>
            <button type="button">
              "End set interval"
      <section aria-label="More actions">
        <button data-testid="phone-action-libero" type="button">
          "Libero"
        <button data-testid="phone-action-sanction" type="button">
          "Sanction"
        <button data-testid="phone-action-replay" disabled="" type="button">
          "Replay"
        <button data-testid="phone-action-decision" disabled="" type="button">
          "Decision change"
        <button data-testid="phone-action-rosters" type="button">
          "Rosters"
        <button data-testid="phone-action-scoresheet" type="button">
          "Score­sheet"
        <button data-testid="phone-action-remarks" type="button">
          "Remarks"
<video loop="" muted="" playsinline="" src="data:video/mp4;base64,">
